observations: Photo 0 shows two red game cases/boxes on a patterned floor mat.
No console (PS4) body, controller(s), cables, or accessories are visible in the photo.
The text on the boxes includes 'SHOW GAMES' and 'YOU FOLLOW OUR GAME' (branding/printing on the box), but no clear PS4 model/console details are readable.

claims.claim: Customized PS4 big, with 2 pads, 7 games and complete accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows game cases/boxes; it does not show the PS4 console, the two controllers (pads), the full set of accessories, or the total number of games.

risks.risk: The console may not be present, may be a different model (e.g., PS4 Slim/Pro), or may not be 'big' as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual PS4 console showing the front label/model markings (and a photo of the back ports).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not verifiable as the claimed PS4 'big' bundle.

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing, may be third-party, or may not work (drift/buttons).
risks.proof: Photos of both controllers with visible charging ports/buttons, plus a short video showing both controllers connecting and responding in a game menu.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: controllers not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: The number of games (7) may be incorrect, and discs may be scratched or not playable.
risks.proof: A photo lineup showing all 7 game cases/discs clearly (front and disc side), or a video scrolling through the installed games/library.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: fewer games and/or untested discs.

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (power cable, HDMI, USB charging cable, headset, etc.).
risks.proof: A single photo showing every accessory laid out together (power/HDMI/USB cables and any other items) with a checklist.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: accessories incomplete.

risks.risk: Console condition may be poor (overheating, loud fan, faulty HDMI/USB ports).
risks.proof: A short video booting the PS4 to the home screen and showing audio/video output working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: untested/possible faults.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PS4 console (front + back ports/labels) to confirm 'big' model.
Photos of both controllers (front/back) and close-ups of ports/buttons.
Photo/video showing the PS4 booting to the home screen with HDMI working.
Photo lineup of all games (confirm exactly 7) with disc condition (disc side).
Photo of all accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, USB cables, etc.) to confirm 'complete accessories'.
response.reason: The only image shows game cases/boxes; there is no visible PS4 console, controllers, accessories, or confirmation of the claimed bundle size/condition. Without those decisive photos/videos, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
